title: Exact dropout and a reproducible sampling check
promptMarkdown: For fixed activationsa=(2,−1), unit output weights and independent inverted dropout with keep probabilityq=.5, enumerate the output distribution and derive mean, variance and expected squared error for targety=3. Write and run a standard-library Monte Carlo check with seed 17 and100000 masks; report sample mean, second moment and squared error. State a reasonable sampling-error scale and explain why deterministic evaluation gives a different squared error.
hintLadder: Enumerate the four masks before using randomness.
Specify keep probability and inverted scaling, not just “dropout .5”.
